verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents an implicit incident timeline (triggered/acknowledged/escalated events, dashboard view) plus a Scribe Agent that transcribes incident calls in real time and Post-Incident Reviews that integrate incident lifecycle events, Slack chat data, and Scribe transcripts into a 'chronological incident narrative' that teams can build/annotate after the fact from the incident page or Slack. This covers alerts, actions, and chat decisions being captured and later turned into an editable report, but there is no explicit doc describing a single unified, directly-editable incident timeline UI (only the PIR narrative and dashboard views), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of how faithfully chat decisions are captured. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an inline, directly editable/annotatable incident timeline (not just a separate PIR document), and independent verification of chat-capture fidelity.
